newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.04 pct in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.04 pct in listless trade.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.04 percent to close at 1.0675 per dollar in listless trade on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
Players are expecting a new decline in the reais-dollar mini-band on Tuesday or Wednesday, they added.
The current mini-band was set on Thursday by the Central Bank at between 1.0670 and 1.0720 reais per dollar.
So far this month, the mini-band has fallen 0.33 percent against the dollar compared to an average drop of between 0.57 and 0.61 percent in the past four months.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real fell 0.12 percent to end at 1.0730 per dollar due to an increase in the dollar's demand, dealers said.
In the parallel market, the real closed unchanged at 1.130 per dollar, traders said.
